capabilities: Create and edit one-time and recurring tasks
Track progress, due dates, execution dates, and subtasks
Archive completed tasks as Markdown files
Run a configurable Pomodoro timer with sound notifications
Split tasks into subtasks with DeepSeek models
extras: AI task splitting is off by default and sends task title, description, and optional prompt file to DeepSeek; no telemetry. README says community-directory listing is pending, so manual install is documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage one-time and recurring tasks with progress, due dates, archiving, and a focus timer.

relations.evidence: Optionally split tasks into subtasks with DeepSeek models.

summary: Task manager and Pomodoro timer that stores tasks as Markdown files in configurable folders, with optional DeepSeek subtask splitting.
